## Voice calls that work

This release is about the thing you actually want from a chat app: **joining a voice call and being heard**.

### 🎙️ The microphone now works on macOS

Previous builds never declared microphone access to macOS, so Yapper could not capture audio even when the call connected. That is fixed.

The first time you join a voice channel, macOS will ask whether **yapmod** can use your microphone. Click **Allow** and you are in. yapmod will then appear in **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone**, where you can change the permission later.

Camera access is set up the same way, ready for camera-based features.

### 📣 If you already denied the prompt

macOS remembers the first answer. If you said no before, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone** and enable **yapmod**. If yapmod is not listed, run this in Terminal and relaunch the app:

```bash
tccutil reset Microphone io.ilyeshdz.yapmod
```

### 🆕 Also in this release

- **Update checks:** yapmod now tells you when a newer version is available and links you to the download page.
- **Changelog in settings:** the Yapmod settings section now shows the notes for every release, so you do not have to come back here to see what changed.
- **Documentation site with search:** setup, first-launch, troubleshooting and developer docs now live on the website with full-text search.
- **Settings fixes:** switching sections no longer leaves the previous panel visible, and settings from older versions migrate correctly.
- **Linux:** the app uses the proper Tux icon again.

### 📥 Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `yapmod_0.3.0_aarch64.dmg` |
| macOS (Intel) | `yapmod_0.3.0_x64.dmg` |
| Windows | `yapmod_0.3.0_x64-setup.exe` or `yapmod_0.3.0_x64_en-US.msi` |
| Linux | `yapmod_0.3.0_amd64.AppImage`, `.deb`, or `.rpm` |

> **macOS note:** builds are ad-hoc signed but not notarized. On first launch, right-click yapmod and choose **Open**, or allow it in **System Settings → Privacy & Security**.

Thanks for using yapmod. If the microphone still does not behave, open an issue with your macOS version and what you see.
